name: protection_jail_capacity
description: Test 30 (PR14, 9.1): police jail 21 with capacity property 500 and no jail budget item (purpose 0xEA56768A): the jail funding is 1.0 (the jail fundingOf returns 1.0 without an item), efficiency curveA0(100) x 0.01f = 100 x 0.01f = 1.0 (shipped curve (100, 100)) -> GetJailCapacity(21) = roundHalfEven(500 x 1.0) = 500; with jailed 100 Recalculate gives capacity 500, ratio f32(100 / 500) = 0.2, the jail's population property roundHalfEven(500 x 0.2) = 100. The capacity property then removed: GetJailCapacity(21) reads it as 0 -> 0; Recalculate with only that jail -> total capacity 0 -> ratio 0 (capacity <= 0), population property 0, total population 0, although jailed (100) is above the capacity. Hand-derived from 6.1 and 9.1.
